mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 4.0% compresses discount rates and signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is always active without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: The Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03, or the average 20-day forward return when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0% is negative (p>0.05 in t-test against zero).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.0% signals restrictive monetary policy, increasing discount rates and compressing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 20-day forward return when FEDFUNDS > 4.0 is positive (p>0.05 in t-test against zero) or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When both federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% and CPIAUCSL exceeds 200, it signals restrictive monetary policy combined with high inflation, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 20-day forward return when FEDFUNDS > 4.0 AND CPIAUCSL > 200 is positive (p>0.05 in t-test against zero) or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (defined by a 3-month rise in FEDFUNDS exceeding 0.5%), restrictive policy compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 20-day forward return during periods when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5% in 3 months is positive (p>0.05 in t-test against zero) or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing market activity (HOUST above 2200) signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 20-day forward return when HOUST > 2200 is negative (p>0.05 in t-test against zero) or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production (INDPRO above 105) signals robust supply chain activity and economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 20-day forward return when INDPRO > 105 is negative (p>0.05 in t-test against zero) or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment (UNRATE below 4.5%) signals a tight labor market and strong economic conditions, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 20-day forward return when UNRATE < 4.5 is negative (p>0.05 in t-test against zero) or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When both housing starts (HOUST) exceed 2200 and retail sales (RSAFS) exceed 350000, it signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 20-day forward return when HOUST > 2200 AND RSAFS > 350000 is negative (p>0.05 in t-test against zero) or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
